'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Michael Pistone LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Michael Pistone]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Live Together Die Alone
* '''Username:''' Pistone84
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
